comments.author: Almeida
comments.body:
3. (head south from entrance to boulders) On the ground there are large tracks that look like a cat's. In which case, the scratches on the trees around here could be from its claws. Something with claws that big could easily attack a human. The tracks head off West.

4. (stacked boulders) Lying in the trail were the remains of a deer 2m long. This animal seems to have preyed on it. It can hunt an animal that big. The tracks head further West. [North]

5. Just now I heard the cry of a cat. I can't imagine a scary beast from that call, but it's coming from where the tracks go... The animal that fed on the deer and the one we just heard are presumably the same. The tracks head off West. [North - stacked boulders, then 27S, 53W from that spot [Observe can be used here]]

comments.author: Snipe
comments.body: Edited the quest, thanks for the info :D
